use ApiPlatform\Metadata\HttpOperation;

use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Exception\RuntimeException;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Exception\UnexpectedValueException;
/**
 * Shared support gates and denormalization logic for the JSON:API item (de)normalizer.
 *
 * @author Kévin Dunglas <dunglas@gmail.com>
 *
 * @internal
 */
trait ItemNormalizerTrait
{
    public function getSupportedTypes(?string $format): array
    {
        return self::FORMAT === $format ? parent::getSupportedTypes($format) : [];
    }
    public function supportsDenormalization(mixed $data, string $type, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): bool
    {
        return self::FORMAT === $format && parent::supportsDenormalization($data, $type, $format, $context);
    }
    /**
     * @throws NotNormalizableValueException

    public function denormalize(mixed $data, string $type, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): mixed
    {

        // unwrapped from the JSON:API structure by the first pass. Skip extraction.
        if (isset($context['api_platform_input'])) {

        }
        $operation = $context['operation'] ?? null;
        $isPostOperation = $operation instanceof HttpOperation && 'POST' === $operation->getMethod();
        $allowClientGeneratedId = true === ($context[ItemNormalizer::ALLOW_CLIENT_GENERATED_ID] ?? $this->defaultContext[ItemNormalizer::ALLOW_CLIENT_GENERATED_ID] ?? false);
        // Avoid issues with proxies if we populated the object
        if (!isset($context[AbstractItemNormalizer::OBJECT_TO_POPULATE]) && isset($data['data']['id'])) {
            if ($isPostOperation) {
                if (!$allowClientGeneratedId) {
                    throw new NotNormalizableValueException(\sprintf('Client-generated IDs are not allowed on this operation. Set the "%s" denormalization context flag (or the bundle "allow_client_generated_id" configuration) to enable it.', ItemNormalizer::ALLOW_CLIENT_GENERATED_ID));

            } elseif (true !== ($context['api_allow_update'] ?? true)) {
                throw new NotNormalizableValueException('Update is not allowed for this operation.');
            } else {
                $context += ['fetch_data' => false];
                if ($this->useIriAsId) {
                    $context[AbstractItemNormalizer::OBJECT_TO_POPULATE] = $this->iriConverter->getResourceFromIri($data['data']['id'], $context);
                } elseif ($operation instanceof HttpOperation) {
                    $iri = $this->reconstructIri($type, (string) $data['data']['id'], $operation);
                    $context[AbstractItemNormalizer::OBJECT_TO_POPULATE] = $this->iriConverter->getResourceFromIri($iri, $context);
                }
            }
        }
        $dataToDenormalize = array_merge(
            $data['data']['attributes'] ?? [],
            $data['data']['relationships'] ?? []
        );
        // Surface the client-generated id so the entity setter receives it.
        if ($isPostOperation && $allowClientGeneratedId && isset($data['data']['id'])) {
            $dataToDenormalize[ReservedAttributeNameConverter::JSON_API_RESERVED_ATTRIBUTES['id']] = $data['data']['id'];
        }

    }

    {

    }

     * @see http://jsonapi.org/format/#document-resource-object-linkage
     *
     * @throws RuntimeException
     * @throws UnexpectedValueException

    protected function denormalizeRelation(string $attributeName, ApiProperty $propertyMetadata, string $className, mixed $value, ?string $format, array $context): ?object
    {
        if (!\is_array($value) || !isset($value['id'], $value['type'])) {
            throw new UnexpectedValueException('Only resource linkage supported currently, see: http://jsonapi.org/format/#document-resource-object-linkage.');
        }

            $context += ['fetch_data' => true];
            if ($this->useIriAsId) {
                return $this->iriConverter->getResourceFromIri($value['id'], $context);
            }
            /** @var HttpOperation $getOperation */
            $getOperation = $this->resourceMetadataCollectionFactory->create($className)->getOperation(httpOperation: true);
            $iri = $this->reconstructIri($className, (string) $value['id'], $getOperation);
            return $this->iriConverter->getResourceFromIri($iri, $context);
        } catch (ItemNotFoundException $e) {
            if (!isset($context['not_normalizable_value_exceptions'])) {
                throw new RuntimeException($e->getMessage(), $e->getCode(), $e);
            }
            $context['not_normalizable_value_exceptions'][] = NotNormalizableValueException::createForUnexpectedDataType(
                $e->getMessage(),
                $value,
                [$className],
                $context['deserialization_path'] ?? null,
                true,
                $e->getCode(),
                $e
            );
            return null;
        }
    }
    /**
     * Maps the id to the operation's single URI variable parameter and generates the IRI.
     * Composite identifiers on a single Link work naturally since the composite string
     * (e.g. "field1=val1;field2=val2") is passed as-is.
     */
    private function reconstructIri(string $resourceClass, string $id, HttpOperation $operation): string
    {
        $uriVariables = $operation->getUriVariables() ?? [];
        if (\count($uriVariables) > 1) {
            throw new UnexpectedValueException(\sprintf('JSON:API entity identifier mode requires operations with a single URI variable, operation "%s" has %d. Consider adding a NotExposed Get operation on the resource.', $operation->getName() ?? $operation->getUriTemplate(), \count($uriVariables)));
        }
        $parameterName = array_key_first($uriVariables) ?? 'id';
        return $this->iriConverter->getIriFromResource($resourceClass, UrlGeneratorInterface::ABS_PATH, $operation, ['uri_variables' => [$parameterName => $id]]);
    }

            throw ApiException::badParameter('sort', 'The sort parameter must be a comma separated list of fields.');

        foreach (explode(',', $raw) as $item) {

            if (!\in_array($field, $allowed, true)) {

<?php

namespace App\OpenApi;

use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Factory\OpenApiFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\MediaType;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Parameter;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\PathItem;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\RequestBody;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Response;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\OpenApi;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AsDecorator;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AutowireDecorated;

/**
 * Completes the OpenAPI document generated by API Platform: query parameters (filters, sort,
 * include, pagination), the Customer-Id header, request bodies, error responses, and the
 * sales report, which is a plain Symfony controller.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.openapi.factory')]
final class OpenApiFactory implements OpenApiFactoryInterface
{
    private const JSON_API = 'application/vnd.api+json';

    public function __construct(#[AutowireDecorated] private readonly OpenApiFactoryInterface $decorated)
    {
    }

    public function __invoke(array $context = []): OpenApi
    {
        $openApi = ($this->decorated)($context);

        // The generated document declares OpenAPI 3.2.0; the API is described with 3.1.0.
        $version = new \ReflectionProperty(OpenApi::class, 'openapi');
        $version->setValue($openApi, '3.1.0');

        $paths = $openApi->getPaths();
        foreach ($this->operations() as $spec) {
            $pathItem = $paths->getPath($spec['path']) ?? new PathItem();
            $operation = $this->operation($pathItem, $spec['method'], $spec);
            $paths->addPath($spec['path'], $this->withOperation($pathItem, $spec['method'], $operation));
        }

        return $openApi;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{path: string, method: string, summary: string, parameters: list<Parameter>, requestBody?: RequestBody, responses: array<string, Response>}>
     */
    private function operations(): array
    {
        $page = [$this->param('page[number]', 'query', 'Page number, from 1.', false, ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1, 'default' => 1]), $this->param('page[size]', 'query', 'Items per page, from 1 to 50.', false, ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1, 'maximum' => 50, 'default' => 10])];
        $customer = $this->param('Customer-Id', 'header', 'Id of the customer making the request.', true, ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1]);
        $id = fn (string $resource): Parameter => $this->param('id', 'path', sprintf('Id of the %s.', $resource), true, ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1]);
        $include = fn (string $allowed): Parameter => $this->param('include', 'query', sprintf('Comma separated relationship paths to include in "included": %s.', $allowed), false, ['type' => 'string']);

        $errors = fn (array $statuses): array => array_combine(
            array_map('strval', array_keys($statuses)),
            array_map(fn (string $description): Response => $this->error($description), array_values($statuses)),
        );

        $bookFilters = [
            $this->param('filter[title]', 'query', 'Title contains the text, case-insensitive.', false, ['type' => 'string']),
            $this->param('filter[author]', 'query', 'Author name, exact.', false, ['type' => 'string']),
            $this->param('filter[minPrice]', 'query', 'Minimum price in cents, included.', false, ['type' => 'integer']),
            $this->param('filter[maxPrice]', 'query', 'Maximum price in cents, included.', false, ['type' => 'integer']),
            $this->param('filter[publishedAfter]', 'query', 'Published on or after this date.', false, ['type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date']),
            $this->param('filter[publishedBefore]', 'query', 'Published on or before this date.', false, ['type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date']),
            $this->param('filter[inStock]', 'query', 'true: only books with stock greater than 0; false: only books with stock 0.', false, ['type' => 'boolean']),
        ];
        $sort = $this->param('sort', 'query', 'Comma separated fields among priceCents, title, publishedAt; prefix with - for descending. Default: id.', false, ['type' => 'string']);

        $bookBody = $this->body('Partial update of a book; only the attributes sent change.', ['title' => ['type' => 'string'], 'priceCents' => ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 0], 'stock' => ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 0]], 'books');
        $purchaseBody = $this->body('Lines of the purchase.', ['lines' => ['type' => 'array', 'minItems' => 1, 'items' => ['type' => 'object', 'required' => ['bookId', 'quantity'], 'properties' => ['bookId' => ['type' => 'integer'], 'quantity' => ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1]]]]], 'purchases');

        return [
            ['path' => '/authors', 'method' => 'get', 'summary' => 'List the authors.', 'parameters' => [...$page], 'responses' => $errors([400 => 'Invalid page parameter.'])],
            ['path' => '/authors/{id}', 'method' => 'get', 'summary' => 'Get an author and its published books.', 'parameters' => [$id('author'), $include('books')], 'responses' => $errors([400 => 'Invalid include path.', 404 => 'Unknown author.'])],

            ['path' => '/books/{id}', 'method' => 'patch', 'summary' => 'Update the title, price or stock of a book.', 'parameters' => [$id('book')], 'requestBody' => $bookBody, 'responses' => $errors([409 => 'The id of the body differs from the URL.', 415 => 'Content-Type is not application/vnd.api+json.', 422 => 'Invalid attribute, nothing changed.', 404 => 'Unknown book.'])],
            ['path' => '/purchases', 'method' => 'get', 'summary' => "List the customer's purchases, most recent first.", 'parameters' => [$customer, ...$page], 'responses' => $errors([400 => 'Invalid page parameter.', 401 => 'Missing or unknown Customer-Id.'])],
            ['path' => '/purchases/{id}', 'method' => 'get', 'summary' => "Get one of the customer's purchases.", 'parameters' => [$customer, $id('purchase')], 'responses' => $errors([401 => 'Missing or unknown Customer-Id.', 404 => 'Unknown purchase.'])],
            ['path' => '/purchases', 'method' => 'post', 'summary' => 'Buy books.', 'parameters' => [$customer], 'requestBody' => $purchaseBody, 'responses' => $errors([401 => 'Missing or unknown Customer-Id.', 402 => 'The payment was declined.', 409 => 'Not enough stock.', 415 => 'Content-Type is not application/vnd.api+json.', 422 => 'Invalid line or unknown or unpublished book.', 502 => 'The payment service failed.'])],
            [
                'path' => '/reports/sales',
                'method' => 'get',
                'summary' => 'Download the CSV report of the books sold between two dates, included.',
                'parameters' => [
                    $this->param('from', 'query', 'First day, included (YYYY-MM-DD).', true, ['type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date']),
                    $this->param('to', 'query', 'Last day, included (YYYY-MM-DD).', true, ['type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date']),
                ],
                'responses' => [
                    '200' => new Response('CSV report: title, quantity, revenueCents.', new \ArrayObject(['text/csv' => new MediaType(new \ArrayObject(['type' => 'string']))])),
                    ...$errors([400 => 'from or to missing, malformed, or from after to.']),
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param array{path: string, method: string, summary: string, parameters: list<Parameter>, requestBody?: RequestBody, responses: array<string, Response>} $spec
     */
    private function operation(PathItem $pathItem, string $method, array $spec): Operation
    {
        $existing = match ($method) {
            'get' => $pathItem->getGet(),
            'post' => $pathItem->getPost(),
            'patch' => $pathItem->getPatch(),
        };

        $operation = $existing ?? new Operation(
            operationId: strtolower($method) . str_replace(['/', '{', '}', '[', ']'], ['_', '', '', '', ''], $spec['path']),
            tags: [trim(explode('/', $spec['path'])[1], '{}')],
            responses: [],
            summary: $spec['summary'],
        );

        $operation = $operation->withParameters($spec['parameters']);
        if (isset($spec['requestBody'])) {
            $operation = $operation->withRequestBody($spec['requestBody']);
        }
        foreach ($spec['responses'] as $status => $response) {
            $operation = $operation->withResponse($status, $response);
        }

        return $operation;
    }

    private function withOperation(PathItem $pathItem, string $method, Operation $operation): PathItem
    {
        return match ($method) {
            'get' => $pathItem->withGet($operation),
            'post' => $pathItem->withPost($operation),
            'patch' => $pathItem->withPatch($operation),
        };
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     */
    private function param(string $name, string $in, string $description, bool $required, array $schema): Parameter
    {
        return new Parameter($name, $in, $description, $required, schema: $schema);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, array<string, mixed>> $properties attributes of the resource
     */
    private function body(string $description, array $properties, string $type): RequestBody
    {
        $schema = [
            'type' => 'object',
            'required' => ['data'],
            'properties' => [
                'data' => [
                    'type' => 'object',
                    'required' => ['type', 'attributes'],
                    'properties' => [
                        'type' => ['type' => 'string', 'enum' => [$type]],
                        'id' => ['type' => 'string'],
                        'attributes' => ['type' => 'object', 'description' => $description, 'properties' => $properties],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        return new RequestBody(
            $description,
            new \ArrayObject([self::JSON_API => new MediaType(new \ArrayObject($schema))]),
            true,
        );
    }

    private function error(string $description): Response
    {
        return new Response(
            $description,
            new \ArrayObject([self::JSON_API => new MediaType(new \ArrayObject(['$ref' => '#/components/schemas/Error.jsonapi']))]),
        );
    }
}
